title: AEO Will Be Won With Solutions That Provide Intelligence, Orchestration, And Outcomes
body_markdown:
Answer engines like ChatGPT, AI Mode, and Claude[mediate brand growth](https://www.forrester.com/report/turn-aeo-into-brand-growth/RES197904?ref_search=3520107_1788276813634) . They institutionalize word of mouth, determine consideration sets, and[increasingly monetize](https://www.forrester.com/report/answer-engine-monetization-outlook-q2-2026/RES194511?ref_search=3520107_1788276813634) . Marketers eager to influence how answer engines perceive their brands are rushing to enact answer engine optimization (AEO)[best practices](https://www.forrester.com/report/best-practices-for-answer-engine-optimization-aeo/RES188745?ref_search=3520107_1788276813634) ,[connect roles](https://www.forrester.com/report/answer-engine-optimization-aeo-role-connections-tool/RES189795?ref_search=3520107_1788276813634) critical to AEO, and[mature AEO competencies](https://www.forrester.com/report/assess-your-answer-engine-optimization-aeo-maturity/RES193785?ref_search=3520107_1788276813634) . As they do, marketers are pitched by various technology vendors promising to improve brands’ visibility, sentiment, and outcomes across answer engines.


The market for AEO technologies is booming. Adobe’s acquisition of Semrush for ~$1.9 billion, Sitecore’s acquisition of Scrunch for ~$225 million, and Profound’s $1 billion+ valuation punctuate the market’s dynamism and category-breaking momentum. Social listening, reputation management, CRM, PR, competitive intelligence, local listing, and content delivery vendors are crowding into the AEO market. But marketers shouldn’t mistake vendor proliferation for market maturity. AEO technologies comprise an emerging market that rewards breakneck innovation and intersects with agentic AI. As answer engines become ever more influential arbiters of brand growth, marketers should favor vendors that:


- **Build proprietary intelligence advantages.** Today, most AEO technologies license common synthetic datasets, forcing marketers to evaluate vendors on data science capabilities rather than unique source data. In the near term, vendors’ differentiation will stem from the proprietary behavioral data they glean to measure prompt volumes and help marketers prioritize FAQs to address. Vendors that generate unique, extensive answer engine intelligence will remain essential even as answer engines launch native analytics tools.
- **Orchestrate AEO.** What sets the most mature AEO practitioners apart from laggards is how they coordinate and govern AEO across disciplines. AEO is a fragile process, not another team. It requires data harmonization between social listening and content creation, extensive executive sponsorship, CTOs and CISOs syncing to make pages crawlable, and much more. AEO technologies that turn organizational chaos into coordinated action will become indispensable.
- **Connect answer engine visibility and sentiment to business outcomes.** To date, no AEO technology can deterministically answer questions like, “how did improving sentiment from neutral to positive in ChatGPT impact household penetration?” or “how did lifting citation rate from 32% to 46% drive sales?” The first AEO technologies to answer such questions in collaboration with leading marketing measurement and optimization providers will outperform.


## Introducing Forrester’s AEO Technologies Landscape


To help marketers establish a durable, cross-functional approach to building authority across answer engines, we published[The Answer Engine Optimization Technologies Landscape, Q3 2026](https://www.forrester.com/report/the-answer-engine-optimization-technologies-landscape-q3-2026/RES200000203?ref_search=3520107_1788276813634) . Our report defines AEO technologies and clarifies the value marketers should expect from them. It explains the market’s maturity and dynamics, catalogues notable vendors, and identifies top use cases and functionalities. It recommends how to work with AEO technology vendors and foresees how the market will evolve.
